findings.finding: Overlap exemption accepts any named Hit/HitMinus/HitPlus pair under any Row in any settings state, including cross-row and toggle pairs. Restrict to exact same Rowmusic/Rowsfx Hit versus Minus/HitMinus or Plus/HitPlus paths. Observed 8 intended pairs per viewport, all reason gamepad selection surface.
Unlogged class/ownership heuristic skips every ImageLabel/ImageButton with a shapeOwner, including meaningful icons and controls. Replace with explicit background/decor paths and count exemptions.

No identity inequality excludes self-collisions; self rows are passed as own-control/duplicate/edge composition. Exclude L.inst == d before pair tests; identify real duplicate layers by explicit pairing.
Clipping/collision discovery excludes non-text FitSticker objects, e.g. Screen_vs/Panel/Group/Content/Dot1..3 Frames. Include visible non-text stickers.
GUI is destroyed before GetDescendants button census at line 292, so default run always reports zero. Count before destruction.

Execution record cites 73316be screen-point rule; PR body and task note correctly cite 9ccb8eb design-unit results. Nonblocking evidence mismatch; append superseding exec evidence without erasing history.
